calibration_sources: CNCF Nydus (RAFS v6) & AWS SOCI Lazy Container Image Streaming Benchmarks
Run:ai Model Streamer (Multi-threaded O_DIRECT bypassing mmap page faults) & NVIDIA GDS cuFileRead
P2P RDMA Weight Distribution (Dragonfly / Kraken / NCCL Broadcast from Stripe Leaders & Host Pinned RAM Daemon)

workload.cluster_and_model: 64 Nodes x 8 H100 GPUs (512 GPUs total) rolling out DeepSeek-V3 671B FP8 (685 GB weights + 22 GB CUDA container)
workload.storage_incast_bottleneck: 64 nodes x 685 GB = 43.84 TB concurrent read storm saturating a 100 Gbps shared storage gateway for 410s
workload.mmap_page_fault_trap: Python default safetensors mmap() over network/FUSE triggers 179M 4KB OS page faults and pollutes Linux Page Cache

tiers.name: Tier 1: 64节点并发拉取 22GB 镜像 + 共享 S3/NFS mmap() 直读未分片 Safetensors (43.8TB 读风暴阻塞 410秒)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: 64-Node Concurrent 22GB Image Pull + Shared S3/NFS Unsharded Safetensors mmap() (410.0s Stall)
tiers.image_and_weight_distribution: Full 22GB tar.gz pull per node + 64 nodes concurrently reading 685GB over shared 100G S3/NFS gateway
tiers.host_to_gpu_ingestion_path: OS mmap() 4KB page-fault storm + redundant full-file read across TP/EP ranks before slicing
tiers.recommended_for: Single-node local NVMe debugging only; causes a 43.8 TB storage read storm at 64-node scale.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 将几百 GB 权重直接打入巨型 Docker/OCI 容器镜像层 (单线程 gzip 解压 540秒 + 撑爆 Kubelet 根分区)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Monolithic 700GB Weight-Baked OCI Container Image (540.0s Decompression + DiskPressure Crash)
tiers.image_and_weight_distribution: 707 GB monolithic OCI image pulled through containerd registry mirror and unpacked to overlayfs
tiers.host_to_gpu_ingestion_path: CPU-bound tar.gz decompression writes 2x707GB to local rootfs, triggering Kubelet DiskPressure eviction
tiers.recommended_for: Never recommended for >7B models; couples 1-line code changes to 700GB image pushes and crashes node disks.

tiers.name: Tier 3: Nydus/SOCI 按需块流式镜像 (3.2s 启动) + TP/EP 预切分 Safetensors + Run:ai O_DIRECT / GDS
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Nydus/SOCI Lazy OCI Streaming (3.2s) + Pre-Sharded Safetensors + O_DIRECT / GDS (38.5s)
tiers.image_and_weight_distribution: Nydus RAFS v6 chunk-level lazy image mount (only 6% read at boot) + pre-sharded rank-specific Safetensors
tiers.host_to_gpu_ingestion_path: Bypasses OS Page Cache via multi-threaded O_DIRECT / cuFileRead GDS directly into pinned RAM / HBM
tiers.recommended_for: Small-to-medium clusters (1-8 nodes) with high-bandwidth parallel storage or pre-staged local NVMe.

tiers.name: Tier 4: Nydus 按需镜像 + 单次存储读取 (0.685TB) + 400G RDMA Ring/Tree P2P 跨机广播 + Pinned DRAM 守护缓存
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Nydus Lazy OCI + Leader-Once Storage Read + 400G RDMA P2P Broadcast + Pinned RAM Cache (6.4s)
tiers.image_and_weight_distribution: Stripe leaders read 685GB from storage exactly ONCE (64x less storage traffic) and multicast over 400G RDMA
tiers.host_to_gpu_ingestion_path: RDMA Write / NCCL Broadcast into node Pinned-DRAM Daemon (/dev/shm) + PCIe Gen5 DMA to HBM at 107 GB/s
tiers.recommended_for: Large-scale 64-1024+ GPU production serving, RL checkpoint sync, and rapid autoscaling fleets.
